_readme: Delivery specs for printerpro.nl orders, used by the PrinterPro File Checker.
Values for categories with "confirmed": true were copied verbatim from
https://www.printerpro.nl/aanleverspecificaties on 2026-09-16 (Affiches,
Ansichtkaarten, Balie displays). All other categories currently INHERIT the
same 'default' block because those three confirmed categories were identical
to each other -- but this has NOT been verified per-category on the site.
Before relying on this for a category marked "confirmed": false, open the
matching anchor at printerpro.nl/aanleverspecificaties/#<anchor> and correct
the values here (or just flip 'confirmed' to true if they match).
Fields:
dpi_min / dpi_recommended : image resolution in DPI
bleed_mm                  : required bleed on each edge
safety_margin_mm          : keep-away zone for important content (manual check only)
crop_marks                : whether crop marks are expected
fonts_embedded_required   : all fonts must be embedded in the PDF
rich_black_cmyk           : recommended CMYK values for deep/rich black (informational)
border_min_mm             : min width of a design border/frame, excl. bleed (informational)
pdf_standard              : e.g. PDF/X-4:2010 (informational, hard to verify byte-exact)
pdf_min_version           : minimum PDF spec version required (e.g. 1.6)
cmyk_profile / rgb_profile: recommended ICC profiles (informational)
page_count_multiple_of    : null unless the site confirms a binding rule (e.g. saddle-stitch booklets)
contour_cut                : whether a cut/die-line contour is expected (stickers etc.)
notes                     : free-text reminders shown in the report, not auto-checked
